title: Kids Summer Camp
location: Aarohana Yoga Studio, 135B, 2nd Floor, Opp HDFC Bank, Jawaharlal Nehru Rd, BEML Layout, 4th Stage, RR Nagar, Bengaluru
tagline: Holistic learning for kids aged 6 to 14.
description: A joyful summer camp designed to help children build calm, confidence, and healthy habits through mantra chanting, mindfulness practice, yoga, breath work, storytelling, and fun activities. The camp blends movement, stillness, creativity, and values-based learning in a nurturing studio environment.

title: Meditation for Healing
tagline: Cultivate a pure and clear mind with guided meditation.
description: A beginner-friendly online meditation course for anyone seeking deeper self-understanding, self-love, and emotional healing. Guided sessions support you in quieting the mind, building self-awareness, cultivating compassion, and moving toward clarity, balance, and inner transformation.
audience: Beginner friendly; no prior experience needed

title: Inner Child Healing Workshop
location: Aarohana Yoga Studio, 135B, 2nd Floor, Jawaharlal Nehru Rd, BEML Layout, RR Nagar, Bengaluru
tagline: When we silence our inner child, we silence our joy.
description: A guided inner child healing workshop led by Dr. Meenakshi K S, created as a reflective space to reconnect with childhood emotions, soften old wounds, and recover a sense of joy. The session combined guided meditation and healing practices to support emotional release, self-compassion, and deeper inner connection.
